spans.s: RS0149 नष्ट पिष्टि naṣṭa piṣṭi Loosing original shape of mercury by grinding / reducing , to a very fine state of division
AF1330 नष्टमानसः naṣṭamānasaḥ Confusion or absence of mind

AT0229 नस्य nasya Administration of drugs by nasal route, all drugs and measures introduced through nose spread throughout the head and its constituent drugs may influence all the Doṣas, poisons and disease situated in these parts.
AT0230 नस्यधूमाञ्जनादिशु nasyadhūmāñjanādiśu A way to cause harm by administering the poison through the way of nasal application, inhalation (smoking) and collyrium.
SR0248 नासपुटबहिर्भागः nāsapuṭabahirbhāgaḥ Ala of nose. Wing of the nose, Broad portion forming the lateral wall of each nostril.
SR0242 नासा नासिका वा nāsā nāsikā vā Nose -organ of smell
SR0243 नासाक्षिसन्धिः nāsākṣisandhiḥ Inner canthus. The angle at the inner end of the slit between the eye lids.
SR0244 नासानाडी nāsānāḍī Nostril-Anterior nares. External aperture of the nose
SR0245 नासारन्ध्रम् nāsārandhram Nostril. One of the external aperture of the nose
AT0222 नासावभङ्गश्च् nāsāvabhaṅgaśc A bad prognostic sign resulting in the cases of snake bite which means that the nose bridge of the patient becomes bent or collapses.
SR0247 नासाविवरम् nāsāvivaram Nostril. One of the external aperture of the nose.
SR0246 नासास्रोतः nāsāsrotaḥ Nasal meatus. The passage or opening of nose.
SR0249 नासिकापुटं वा nāsikāpuṭaṁ vā Nostril-Anterior nares. External aperture of the nose
AF1311 नासिकाभ्यां रक्तं nāsikābhyāṁ raktaṁ Bleeding through Nose
AF1312 नासिकाविषय अज्ञानम् nāsikāviṣaya ajñānam Anosmia or loss of the sense of smell
